visual_specs.title: Meridian Context Strength Snapshot
visual_specs.purpose: Show planning-grade confidence level across all nineteen dimensions at a glance.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No numeric evidence certified; qualitative confidence snapshot is appropriate.
visual_specs.placement: Home page hero section above story blocks.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All dimensions are planning-grade; no dimension is certified decision-grade.

visual_specs.title: Dimension Readiness Matrix Across Nineteen Domains
visual_specs.purpose: Display readiness status for each dimension using qualitative evidence-confidence ratings.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified numeric baselines; qualitative matrix prevents false precision.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Readiness ratings are hypothesis-grade until owner validation is completed.

visual_specs.title: Top Evidence Requests Blocking Transformation Progress
visual_specs.purpose: Surface the highest-priority evidence gaps preventing initiative advancement.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Evidence requests are qualitative priority signals, not numeric rankings.
visual_specs.placement: Home page secondary panel below context strength snapshot.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All evidence requests are planning-grade until owner validation is received.

visual_specs.title: Seven-Initiative Use Case Portfolio Readiness View
visual_specs.purpose: Display all seven Meridian initiatives with readiness status and primary gap signals.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified readiness scores; qualitative portfolio card view prevents false precision.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All initiatives are hypothesis-grade; no initiative is execution-ready.

visual_specs.title: Data Foundation Gap Map Across Clinical, Claims, and Finance
visual_specs.purpose: Visualize data domain gaps blocking lakehouse, AI, and finance use cases.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Gap map is qualitative; no certified data quality metrics are available.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge data assets section primary panel.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All data domain gaps are planning-grade; harmonization is not yet evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Risk and Control Gap Heatmap Across Transformation Scope
visual_specs.purpose: Highlight control gaps across governance, platform, AI, and PHI-adjacent domains.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified control inventory; qualitative heatmap prevents false assurance.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge risks and controls section primary panel.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All control gaps are planning-grade; no certified posture assessment exists.

visual_specs.title: Value Hypothesis vs. Proof Status Across Seven Initiatives
visual_specs.purpose: Contrast planning-grade value hypotheses against absent proof for each initiative.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No audited savings or realized ROI; hypothesis-vs-proof card view is appropriate.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All value claims are hypothesis-grade; no audited or realized value is evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Nexus Module Next Actions for Meridian
visual_specs.purpose: Surface recommended Nexus module actions to advance evidence collection and readiness.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Module actions are qualitative advisory signals, not numeric outputs.
visual_specs.placement: Home page action panel below top evidence requests.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Module actions are advisory-grade until evidence validation is completed.

visual_specs.title: Application Dependency Map Across Fourteen Identified Systems
visual_specs.purpose: Illustrate integration dependencies and unproven connections across Meridian's application landscape.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Integration topology is planning-grade; no certified API or data-flow evidence exists.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All integration dependencies are planning-grade; no certified topology is evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Program Readiness Matrix for Seven Transformation Initiatives
visual_specs.purpose: Score each initiative across platform, governance, data, and workforce readiness dimensions.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified readiness scores; qualitative matrix prevents misleading numeric precision.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All readiness assessments are planning-grade pending owner validation.

visual_specs.title: Vendor Dependency Matrix Across Seven Identified Vendors
visual_specs.purpose: Map vendor relationships to initiative dependencies and highlight unvalidated contract risks.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified contract terms or spend data; qualitative dependency matrix is appropriate.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All vendor dependencies are planning-grade; contract terms are not yet evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Evidence Confidence Matrix Across All Transformation Dimensions
visual_specs.purpose: Display evidence confidence levels across dimensions to guide next evidence collection priorities.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Confidence levels are qualitative; no certified numeric evidence supports a chart.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge evidence sources section primary panel.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All confidence ratings are planning-grade; no dimension has certified decision-grade evidence.
